quests.instruction: When you make a bed, which layer goes on the mattress first?
quests.hint: Think of the layer that protects the mattress itself.
quests.explanation: The sheet covers the mattress first, then the blanket goes on top, and the pillow sits at the head.
quests.funFact: Many people wash their sheets about once a week.

quests.instruction: Sam's sheets got wet in the night. What is the best thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a grown-up for fresh sheets 🧺
options: Hide the sheets under the bed 🛏️
Cover the wet spot with a pillow ☁️
Tell a grown-up for fresh sheets 🧺
quests.hint: Wet sheets need a wash, and grown-ups know how to help.
quests.explanation: Accidents happen to lots of children, and wet sheets are easy to wash. Telling an adult gets fresh bedding quickly.
quests.funFact: Waterproof mattress covers protect mattresses from spills and accidents.

quests.instruction: Why is it better not to eat crumbly snacks in bed?
quests.correctAnswer: Crumbs can attract ants and bugs 🐜
options: Crumbs can attract ants and bugs 🐜
Pillows are too soft for snacks ☁️
quests.hint: Consider who else might want the crumbs.
quests.explanation: Crumbs left in a bed can attract insects and make the sheets scratchy. Snacks are better eaten at a table.
quests.funFact: An ant that finds a crumb leaves a scent trail, so other ants can follow it to the same spot.

quests.instruction: Zoe wants to find her favorite shirt quickly. Which closet habit helps most?
quests.correctAnswer: Hanging shirts together in one row 👕
options: Piling clothes on the closet floor 🧱
Hanging shirts together in one row 👕
quests.hint: Look for the way that lets her see all her shirts at once.
quests.explanation: Keeping similar things together means one quick look finds what you need.
quests.funFact: Some closets sort clothes by color, which makes choosing quicker.

quests.instruction: Why are heavy knitted sweaters usually folded, not hung?
options: Hangers make them shrink a lot 📏
quests.hint: Work out what a heavy sweater does when it hangs from two narrow points.
quests.explanation: The weight of a knitted sweater pulls it long when it hangs, and the shoulders end up bumpy. Folding keeps its shape.
quests.funFact: Light shirts and dresses crease less when they hang.

quests.instruction: A closet has a rod, a shelf, and a floor. Where does a stack of folded T-shirts fit best?
quests.hint: Folded things need a flat surface.
quests.explanation: Folded stacks sit flat on a shelf. The rod is for things on hangers, and the floor collects dust and gets stepped on.
quests.funFact: Many closet shelves are adjustable, so they can fit tall or short stacks.

quests.instruction: Ella's brother wants to borrow her new drawing set. What should he do?
options: Take it while she is out 🚶
Use it and put it back 🖍️
quests.hint: Things that belong to one person are theirs to lend.
quests.explanation: Asking first shows respect for her things, and she may well say yes. Taking something without asking is not fair, even if you bring it back.
quests.funFact: Asking first keeps trust strong, even between close friends.

quests.instruction: Which of these is usually shared by the whole family?
quests.hint: Think about what is meant for one person and what is meant for everyone.
quests.explanation: A TV in a shared room is for everyone. Toothbrushes and diaries are personal and stay with their owner.
quests.funFact: Shared things are easier to look after when everyone follows the same rules for using them.

quests.instruction: You accidentally break your brother's toy. What is the best thing to do?
quests.hint: Being honest makes it easier to fix.
quests.explanation: Telling the truth and saying sorry is the best way to put things right, and you can offer to help mend it. Hiding it makes things worse.
quests.funFact: Many broken toys can be mended with glue by an adult.

quests.instruction: Nia's desk is covered in paper, crayons, and snack wrappers. What should leave the desk first?
quests.hint: Start with the things nobody is going to use again.
quests.explanation: Trash goes first because nothing is saved and it makes the most mess. After that the rest can be sorted into their homes.
quests.funFact: Clearing your desk at the end of the day gives you a fresh start tomorrow.

quests.instruction: Why is it better to put dirty clothes in a hamper than on the floor?
quests.correctAnswer: They will not get stepped on or lost 🧺
options: A hamper makes clothes look new ✨
They will not get stepped on or lost 🧺
quests.hint: Work out where they end up on laundry day.
quests.explanation: A hamper keeps dirty clothes together and safe from feet. On laundry day you find them all in one place.
quests.funFact: Some hampers are made of mesh so air can reach the clothes inside.

quests.instruction: You cannot find your pencil on a messy desk. Which change helps most?
options: Buy a new pencil every day ✏️
quests.hint: A spot that stays the same means a search takes seconds.
quests.explanation: Things with regular homes are quick to find. Stacking things higher or buying more only adds to the pile.
quests.funFact: Putting something back takes about as long as putting it down somewhere random.

quests.instruction: Tom feels too hot under a thick blanket. What is a comfortable fix?
quests.hint: The aim is to let some warmth out.
quests.explanation: A lighter cover lets extra heat escape, so you stay comfortable. Adding blankets or sealing the room would make you hotter.
quests.funFact: Bodies cool down a little at night, so a slightly cool room helps sleep.

quests.instruction: A bedroom feels stuffy first thing in the morning. What helps?
quests.correctAnswer: Opening a window for fresh air 🪟
options: Opening a window for fresh air 🪟
Hanging a blanket over the window 🧶
quests.hint: Stuffy air needs somewhere to go.
quests.explanation: Fresh air swaps stale air for clean air and makes a room feel lighter. Closing everything up keeps the stuffiness in.
quests.funFact: Many people open the windows for a few minutes each morning to freshen the rooms.

quests.instruction: Lila feels scared when her room is dark at night. What is a good thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up for a night light 🌙
options: Ask a grown-up for a night light 🌙
Keep it a secret and worry 😟
Go outside alone to check it 🚪
quests.hint: Grown-ups have lots of ideas to make nights feel safer.
quests.explanation: Telling an adult helps, and a night light can make a room feel friendlier. Being scared of the dark is very common.
quests.funFact: Lots of children, and even some adults, like a small light on at night.

quests.instruction: How should you climb down the ladder of a bunk bed?
options: Jumping off from the top bunk 🤸
quests.hint: You need your hands and feet in control the whole way.
quests.explanation: Facing the ladder and holding on keeps your balance. Jumping or sliding can lead to a bad fall.
quests.funFact: Bunk beds have rails along the top bunk so sleepers do not roll out.

quests.instruction: A phone charger cord is stretched across the bedroom floor. Why is that a problem?
options: It will make the room warmer 🔥
quests.hint: Think about walking through the room with your eyes half closed.
quests.explanation: A cord across the floor is easy to trip over, especially in the dark. Keeping cords along the wall keeps the paths clear.
quests.funFact: Cord clips and tubes can hold cables neatly against a wall.

quests.instruction: Which of these would hurt most to step on with bare feet in the morning?
quests.hint: Pick the thing that is hard and small.
quests.explanation: Hard toys left on the floor can hurt your feet and make you slip. Putting them away before bed keeps the floor safe.
quests.funFact: A quick tidy before bed means the first step of the day is a safe one.

quests.instruction: It is going to be a hot, sunny day. Which outfit suits it best?
quests.correctAnswer: A light shirt and sun hat 👒
options: A thick coat and warm gloves 🧤
A light shirt and sun hat 👒
A wool scarf and snow boots 🧣
quests.hint: Pick the clothes that keep you cool and shaded.
quests.explanation: Light clothes keep you cool, and a hat shades your face. Heavy winter clothes would make you far too hot.
quests.funFact: Light colors reflect more sunlight than dark ones.

quests.instruction: Cold weather is on its way. Which clothes should move to the front of the closet?
quests.hint: Choose the clothes that trap warmth.
quests.explanation: Warm layers go to the front when the weather turns cold. Summer clothes can move to the back.
quests.funFact: Closets are often swapped over between summer and winter clothes.

quests.instruction: Mika's sleeves are too short and her pants stop above her ankles. What does that most likely mean?
quests.correctAnswer: She has grown and needs a bigger size 📏
options: The clothes need to be ironed again ♨️
She has grown and needs a bigger size 📏
Her closet has grown too small 🗄️
quests.hint: Consider what happens to a child over a year.
quests.explanation: Children grow, so clothes that fit last year can become too small. Needing a bigger size is a sign of growing.
quests.funFact: Children often go through several clothing sizes during a fast growth spurt.

quests.instruction: Rui often wakes up thirsty at night. What is a safe, simple plan?
quests.correctAnswer: Keep a cup of water nearby 🥛
options: Keep a cup of water nearby 🥛
quests.hint: Bring the water to where you sleep.
quests.explanation: A cup by the bed means no walking around in the dark. Climbing or shouting is unsafe or unnecessary.
quests.funFact: A cup with a lid keeps water from spilling on a bedside table.

quests.instruction: You need the bathroom at night. What helps you find the way safely?
options: A lit candle on a plate 🕯️
quests.hint: Pick a light that has no flame.
quests.explanation: A soft light helps you see without waking everyone. Candles can start fires, and running blind could make you fall.
quests.funFact: Some night lights switch on by themselves when it gets dark.

quests.instruction: You wake in the night feeling unwell. What should you do?
options: Wait until morning to say anything ⏳
quests.hint: Grown-ups want to know when you do not feel well.
quests.explanation: Telling an adult right away is best, even in the middle of the night. They can check on you and help you feel better.
quests.funFact: Grown-ups would much rather be woken up than find out in the morning that you were unwell.

quests.instruction: Two sisters share one bedroom. Which arrangement is fairest?
options: Everything goes in one big pile 🧸
quests.hint: Fair means each person has a space that is theirs.
quests.explanation: A space for each person keeps belongings separate and avoids arguments.
quests.funFact: Strips of tape or labels can mark whose shelf is whose.

quests.instruction: One child wants to read while the other is falling asleep. What is a fair solution?
options: Switch on the big ceiling light 💡
Wake the other child to chat 🗣️
quests.hint: Think about a light that does not shine on the sleeper.
quests.explanation: A small light, or a different room, lets one child read while the other sleeps. Sharing a room means thinking about each other.
quests.funFact: Small book lights clip onto a page and shine only where they are needed.

quests.instruction: Toys from two children cover a shared bedroom floor. Whose job is it to pick them up?
options: Only the younger child does it 👶
Only the older child does it 🧑
quests.hint: Everybody cleans up their own mess.
quests.explanation: Each child puts away their own toys, which is fair and quick. One child doing everything would not be fair.
quests.funFact: Separate toy bins make it easy to see whose is whose.

quests.instruction: Mara cannot find her homework in her room. What is the smartest way to look?
options: Empty every drawer onto the floor 🧦
Give up and say she lost it 😞
quests.hint: Start where it should be before searching everywhere.
quests.explanation: Checking the usual spots first is fast and keeps the room tidy. Emptying drawers makes more mess and takes longer.
quests.funFact: Having one regular spot for homework is the easiest way to avoid this problem.

quests.instruction: Your bedroom door will not open from the inside. What is the best first step?
quests.hint: Do not try anything risky. Help is nearby.
quests.explanation: Calling an adult is safe and quick. Hitting the door or climbing out of a window could hurt you.
quests.funFact: Knowing how to unlock your bedroom door from the inside is a skill worth learning early.

quests.instruction: Which job would make a bedroom look tidiest in just two minutes?
quests.hint: The biggest thing in the room makes the biggest difference.
quests.explanation: The bed is the largest thing in a bedroom, so making it changes how the whole room looks. The other jobs take much longer.
quests.funFact: Making the bed is often the first tidy-up job people do in the morning.
